The *Vipākattika* ("The Triad 'karmically resultant, etc.'") is a section of the *Paṭṭhāna* within the Abhidhamma Piṭaka of the Pali Canon [Nyanatiloka 1983]. Structurally cataloged as Patthana 7.3, it forms the third triad in the sequence of 22 triads (*ttika*), situated between the *Vedanāttika* (the triad of feelings) and triads such as the *Upādinnattika* (or *Upādānattika*) and *Saṅkiliṭṭhattika* [Nyanatiloka 1983; DharmaNexus].

Within the broader framework of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the text participates in the systematic structural analysis characteristic of the work's major chapters [Nyanatiloka 1983]. According to automated analysis by DharmaNexus, the text exhibits extensive internal Pali text reuse, sharing 79 passages with 23 other canonical texts in the *Paṭṭhāna* collection [DharmaNexus]. Its closest internal relationships are found with other treatments of the same triad in different structural arrangements—notably *Vipākattika* at Patthana 1.4 (19 matches, including segments §1.1–3.1 aligning with §80.0–82.1_1), Patthana 13.3 (9 matches), and Patthana 19.3 (2 matches)—as well as with neighboring triads such as *Upādinnattika* (Patthana 7.4), *Saṁkiliṭṭhattika* (Patthana 7.5), and *Vitakkattika* (Patthana 7.6) [DharmaNexus]. There are no confirmed cross-language matches recorded [DharmaNexus].
